# Signet 01

A ring that signs. Sterling silver. Twenty numbered rings. Designed by Jim Hannon-Tan in Adelaide.

Touch it to your phone and it seals a statement, a work, or a decision. The key is made inside the ring and cannot be copied out.

## The object

A signet used to be pressed into wax. The mark carried its owner. Signet 01 keeps the gesture and seals with a signature instead of wax.

The square spiral on the face is the antenna. Your phone powers the chip when you touch the ring to it. No battery. The ring is made to be opened, so the chip can be serviced without replacing the silver.

## The gesture

Write a line, or choose an image or a document. Review the exact content. Touch the ring to the phone. Share the seal. A recipient can check that this ring signed this content, and that the content has not changed.

Signing on the chip is demonstrated. The application is in development. Supported phones will be confirmed before delivery.

A signature shows that this ring signed this content. It does not, by itself, prove legal identity.

## Edition 01

Twenty rings, numbered 01 to 20. USD 4,800. Delivery from Q1 2027.
